doc.name: Droppy docs
doc.instructions: This server answers questions about Droppy, a Mac app that turns the notch into a Dynamic Island with a file tray, clipboard manager, live activities, music controls and extensions called droplets. Use search_droppy_docs first for any how-to, setting, shortcut, permission, pricing or troubleshooting question, then fetch_droppy_page to read the best match in full before answering. Use list_droplets to see which droplets exist, which are built in and which come from the Droplet Store. Pricing, licensing and the trial are on /pricing.md and /docs/license; release notes are on /changelog. Every tool is read-only. To let an AI app act on Droppy on a Mac, the user switches on the MCP droplet in Droppy (Settings, Droplet Store, MCP), which runs a separate local server; /docs/mcp explains it.

tools.name: search_droppy_docs
tools.title: Search Droppy docs
tools.description: Search everything on getdroppy.app (the Droppy handbook, every droplet page, the DroppyKit developer docs and the blog) and get ranked pages with a snippet. Use it for any question about how Droppy works, its settings, shortcuts, permissions, pricing or problems.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, for example "clipboard history shortcut".

section.description: docs = the handbook, droplets = droplet pages, droppykit = SDK docs, blog = articles, site = product pages.

tools.name: fetch_droppy_page
tools.title: Read a Droppy page
tools.description: Read one page of getdroppy.app as Markdown, by URL or path, for example "/docs/shelf", "https://getdroppy.app/docs/droplets/ring" or "/pricing.md". Use it after search_droppy_docs to read a result in full.

max_characters.description: Cut the page off after this many characters.

tools.name: list_droplets
tools.title: List droplets
tools.description: List Droppy's droplets: the extensions built into Droppy and the ones in the Droplet Store, with a summary and documentation link for each. Filter by text or by kind.

query.description: Only droplets whose name, id or summary contains this text.

kind.description: Only built-in droplets, or only Droplet Store droplets.

resources.name: droplets
resources.title: Droplets
resources.description: Cards for the droplets list_droplets returns, with a link to each one's documentation.
